payload.description:
As a dispatcher I need Cursor leftover only if a curated wrapper exists. cursor-agent about has plan tier, not used percent. Official personal leftover API does not exist.

Do not invent api2.cursor.sh scraping. If we ship Cursor, pin a named tool (aiquota or CodexBar) and fail closed. Grok Bot weekly is a separate clock.

Feature: Cursor leftover
  Scenario: no official leftover
    Given only cursor-agent about JSON
    When Spotticus asks for Cursor leftover
    Then Cursor is not a dispatch target
payload.title: Cursor leftover has no official CLI; pin an unofficial wrapper or skip
